description:
Aggregate battery metrics across ALL devices of a given brand+model. Returns
mean / median / p25 / p75 / min / max for: temperature (C), battery level (%),
discharge speed (hours per 100%%), AC / USB / wireless charge speed (hours per
100%%), and awake ratio. Use this to characterize how a model behaves in the
field, or to compare a single device against its model average.

Also includes:
  * `raw_model_code`: representative raw Android Build.MODEL identifier (smallest
    among devices grouped under this street name), or null if none recorded.
  * `url`: public BatterySnap web page for the model
    (https://www.battery-snap.com/brands/<brand>/models/<raw_model_code>); null when
    `raw_model_code` is null.

model.description: Model name, matched against resolved street name (e.g. 'Galaxy S23') or raw Build.MODEL (e.g. 'SM-S911B').
